text:
Type: textured stoneware plant pot
Use: holding an indoor plant; on a shelf, table or windowsill in a living room, bedroom, home office
Style: rustic, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: glazed stoneware with an embossed scale texture, raw clay foot
Colors: ivory, sandy beige
Shape: rounded cylinder on a narrow foot, all-over small arch pattern, medium-small, compact
Feel: soft, warm, crafted
Goes with: light wood, linen, neutral walls; Scandinavian, farmhouse or Japandi rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Textured Stoneware Planter, 6.25"H, Ivory
product.description: With its stylish woven pattern, this ivory-glazed pot will set off any kind of plant or flower arrangement, whether indoors or out. Use it as a coffee-table centerpiece, or set it on the steps outside your home for a welcoming touch. 6.75" diameter x 6.25"H; 5.875" interior diameter Made from 100% stoneware for long-lasting durability With a drainage hole in the bottom, this pot is perfect for direct or indirect planting. Woven pattern on the pot's exterior adds dimensional interest. No assembly required Hand wash with a damp cloth.
